figures.after_heading: Regroup one whole before subtracting
figures.caption: Equivalent parts make addition and regrouping visible.
figures.alt: Three eighths is six sixteenths. Adding five sixteenths gives eleven sixteenths. Four and one eighth is four and two sixteenths, or three and eighteen sixteenths. Subtracting two and three sixteenths leaves one and fifteen sixteenths. Adding the difference to the subtracted quantity returns four and one eighth.
